<issue_description>
A bounds-checking error in PackUnix::find_overlay_offset (src/p_unix.cpp) allows a 4-byte read past the end of the input buffer via the little-endian 32-bit reader (get_le32 / N_BELE_RTP::LEPolicy::get32).
